items.title: CrowdStrike Rebounds 2%, Palo Alto Up 2% as Cloudflare Finds “An Even Higher Gear”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCrowdStrike rose 2% today after Cloudflare reported 39% revenue growth and raised its full-year outlook. Cloudflare tied its growth to escalating digital threats, a good sign for security spending.

items.title: $3 trillion wipe-out, CEOs on the volatility of politics, and the status of the AI trade
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi gives his thoughts on the recent tech sell-off and what a bear market means for the AI trade. Plus, what the Qualcomm (QCOM) CEO and other business leaders are saying about the volatile state of politics. 

Sozzi sits down for a 1-on-1 with Affirm (AFRM) CEO Max Levchin to discuss the company's earnings and the midterm results.

items.title: Why Is Dynatrace (DT) Pairing AI Security With Observability Now?
items.summary: Dynatrace (NYSE:DT) and CrowdStrike announced a new partnership to link AI-driven security with observability offerings. The collaboration aims to support federated search, shared security context, and flexible data routing for joint enterprise customers. Both businesses plan to use each other's platforms internally, signaling a deeper product and go to market alignment. items.title: iShares Expanded Tech-Software (IGV) Adds Oracle, Trims Microsoft on Nov. 4
